definitions.explanation: The philosophical position that life, morality, or knowledge has no inherent meaning, value, or foundation. The standard Japanese translation of the European philosophical term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虚無主義|きょむしゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{傾倒|けいとう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
ニーチェ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虚無主義|きょむしゅぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Nietzsche's thought has a deep connection with nihilism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虚無主義|きょむしゅぎ}{的|てき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A nihilistic mood spread among young people in the postwar period.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{虚無|きょむ}→虚無：04847_kyomu⟧ (emptiness; nothingness) + ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (-ism; doctrine). Used both in academic philosophy and as a literary descriptor of a worldview.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虚無主義|きょむしゅぎ}{的|てき}: nihilistic
- {虚無主義|きょむしゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into nihilism
- {虚無主義|きょむしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to overcome nihilism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ニヒリズム: nihilism — loanword; common in critical and pop-culture writing
- {厭世主義|えんせいしゅぎ}: pessimism — about world-weariness, not absence of meaning
- {懐疑主義|かいぎしゅぎ}: skepticism — doubts knowledge, not value
